rules.currency_policy: Rank only comparable values within one currency; do not FX-convert implicitly.
rules.identity_policy: Aggregate only by source-native or canonical stable identifiers. Names and normalized names are display/discovery fields only.
rules.measure_policy: Awarded, obligated, disbursed, paid, assessed, claimed, judgment, contributed, debt par, loan principal, guaranteed, incentivized and estimated values are non-equivalent measures.
rules.tie_policy: Use competition ranking by metric value; deterministic entity_id ordering is display-only and never evidence of superiority.
rules.top_n_policy: Top N includes every entity tied at rank N.
rules.unresolved_policy: Records lacking the adapter's required stable identity or currency never silently contribute to a ranked entity total.
rules.materialization_policy: Adapters backed by staging outputs return OPEN_NOT_MATERIALIZED when their frozen local source manifestation is absent; absence is never treated as a zero-valued universe.
rules.history_policy: Rank movement requires at least two hash-verified comparable snapshots with equal category, measure, ranking contract, filters and currency universe. Source-manifestation changes are dataset deltas and cannot automatically be labeled economic activity.

categories.label: Federal grant obligations

categories.label: Disaster-recovery assistance obligations

categories.label: Federal assistance obligations
categories.reason: bounded assistance-source aggregation by source-native recipient_uei; instrument-specific non-obligation measures are excluded

categories.label: Campaign contributions received by authoritative FEC committee

categories.label: Campaign contributions by donor
categories.reason: donor graph IDs are currently derived from normalized names; name-derived determinism is not canonical donor identity

categories.label: Government payments

categories.label: Procurement awards beyond canonical_v1 contract scope

categories.reason: guaranteed amount is a distinct exposure measure

categories.label: Subsidies and incentives
categories.reason: requires source-specific benefit semantics and stable recipient identity

categories.label: Tax incentives
categories.reason: estimated and realized tax benefits cannot be mixed

categories.label: Lobbying expenditures
